Ruling: preserve every other member including license/entrypoints and attributes; reject signed wheels instead of dropping signatures — narrow testable preservation boundary — cost: no legal/upstream/runtime assurance and signed originals need a separate policy.

Ruling: require classic contiguous single-disk ZIP/no descriptors/extras/comments/ZIP64 plus strict RECORD and resource limits — keeps hostile archive behavior finite and unambiguous — cost: legitimate actual wheel layout may fail closed and real preparation remains unmeasured.

Ruling: caller SHA equality and policy hash are not upstream or transform implementation authentication; all receipts deny execution/prep/native/official status — synthetic fixtures cannot grant authority — cost: futureAPI/Git/source/actualhash proof remains mandatory.

Ruling: use cooperative deadlines for bounded immutable memory work, not process-global timers — no blocking IO/caller callbacks in API — cost: no hard realtime guarantee; actual wrapper IO deadlines remain futurework.
